title: AlexandreJourdan_2013_s3
author: iut_Paris8
changes: Real recording of air bubbling up through the water of an aquarium, used for the goldfish (goldfish make no well-known call). Trimmed to 0.00–1.51 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording, described by the recordist as a bubble in the water of an aquarium. No high-pass is applied because the clip has no measurable low-frequency rumble.
